name: Alex Kumar
headline: Software Developer | Backend & Database Engineering | Oracle · PostgreSQL · PL/SQL · AI-assisted development
summary: Software Developer with 5+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise business applications across construction, manufacturing, pharmacy, retail, and government domains. Oracle Certified Professional with deep backend and database engineering expertise — Oracle (PL/SQL and DBA), PostgreSQL, complex SQL, performance tuning, and large-scale data migration — combined with full-stack delivery experience in JavaScript, Node.js, and Electron.js. Works fluently with modern AI development tools (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT) for code generation, debugging and optimisation, and has built a working LLM-backed calling agent for supplier price enquiries.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Own end-to-end development, enhancement, and production support of the group's core enterprise application platform (Corevia ERP), serving 600+ daily users across construction, hospital, pharmacy, and warehouse operations at multiple sites.

Rebuilt the Cost Reporting module from the ground up — traced and eliminated root-cause data inconsistencies spanning 15+ years of historical cost data, corrected them at the source function level, and delivered a multi-scenario cost engine now running in live production.

Redesigned the Cost Reporting module's rate logic — replaced a flat-average rate model with batch-based costing, retroactively reconstructing virtual batches across 15+ years of historical data that had no native batch tracking, so reported costs reflect real batch-level rates rather than averages.

Planned and executed a large-scale split and migration of 15+ years of historical transactional data across construction, pharmacy, and warehouse modules in Oracle Database, achieving zero data loss with full referential integrity and no interruption to business operations.

Administer 5+ Oracle Database instances as DBA across the group operations in Oman, India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia — schema and user management, backup and recovery strategy, performance tuning, and server configuration.
Develop and optimise complex SQL and PL/SQL (stored procedures, functions, triggers) that power inventory, QA/QC, cost, and finance reporting.
Delivered inventory and warehouse functionality covering goods receipt, inter-site stock transfers, stock adjustments, and operational reporting.
Implemented QA/QC quality-checkpoint workflows embedded directly into the construction project lifecycle.
Partner directly with finance and operations stakeholders to translate business requirements into shipped features.
Hosted and configured Corevia ERP on IIS for internet-based access, serving 600+ daily users in the Oman operation.
Primary support contact for 100+ users daily across HSE, Finance, Procurement and QA/QC teams — resolving ERP issues and translating each team’s workflow needs into system improvements.

Designed the Project Monitoring module to track timelines, budgets, and completion status, with automated escalation alerts routed to district officers and the Chief Minister's Office.
Automated weekly timesheet reporting with a custom HTML/SQL reporting function.
a beverage manufacturer: designed and implemented the EAL Process & Dispatch module with integrated database reporting for excise compliance.
Provided offshore delivery-centre support to two offshore client accounts: database troubleshooting, query performance optimisation, and production uptime management.

experience.title: Associate Software Developer
bullets: Built a full-stack Point of Sale (POS) desktop application using Electron.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, featuring barcode scanning, split invoicing, and real-time inventory tracking — deployed to live retail stores.
Designed and maintained PostgreSQL schemas and optimised queries, indexes, and stored procedures to keep reporting responsive as transaction volume grew.
Developed sales-forecasting logic that improved demand-prediction accuracy for retail clients.
